body:
Removed CarePyreContactHandler, /admin/carepyre back-office page, and route registrations -- the feature and its data now live in IDUNA_PRO gated by a real contacts.manage permission instead of this repo's broad iduna.admin. Old table left in place as a frozen historical backup, 4 real rows migrated forward and verified byte-for-byte, not deleted. var/*.db chmod 674->640 across all files; UMask=0027 added to iduna.service. Live-verified: build/test green, service rebuilt/restarted, old route confirmed 404. Commit 0439da6.

⚓ ☃
title: PII audit: decommission CarePyre contact form (moved to IDUNA_PRO)
